title: Ideal Junta Polynomial Samples
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $P$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and fix signs on $P$. Let $0<\delta\le1/2$, and let a batch of restricted inputs and sign labels be indexed by the restricted sample count. The polynomial sample list selected from this batch is exactly the list whose $i$th entry consists of the reindexed input selected at position $i$ and the value of the reindexed restriction of $f$ at that input; the list has the prescribed polynomial sample count.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ signs
$P$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
batch indexed by the restricted sample count, with restricted inputs and sign labels
